response.sql: WITH album_rates AS (SELECT AlbumId, COUNT(*) AS track_count, AVG(CAST(Bytes AS REAL) / NULLIF(Milliseconds, 0)) AS rate FROM Track GROUP BY AlbumId), overall AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS mean_rate FROM album_rates) SELECT AVG(a.rate) AS average_rate, AVG(a.track_count) AS average_track_count, AVG(a.rate - o.mean_rate) AS average_excess FROM album_rates AS a CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE a.rate > o.mean_rate;

assumptions.assumption: A track with zero Milliseconds has an undefined rate and is excluded from the rate calculation; the schema does not rule out zero.
